title: Justice Department Sues Lyft for Denying Rides to Passengers with Service Dogs, Wheelchairs
summary: Today, the Justice Department (Department) filed a lawsuit against Lyft Inc., for discriminating against passengers with disabilities, including those who use service animals and mobility devices such as stowable wheelchairs. Lyft provides an important transportation option for millions of people throughout the United States. The lawsuit seeks $53 million for individuals with disabilities who Lyft has discriminated against, and who have submitted complaints to Lyft or the Department.
